items.title_zh: 肉类 × 辅料 搭配表
items.desc_en: What to add to each cut, how much, when — and what it actually does. Plus the myths worth dropping.
items.desc_zh: 每种肉配什么辅料、放多少、什么时候放，以及它真正的作用；附几个可以放下的常见说法。

items.desc_en: Angelica root (白芷), or soak out the blood, then vinegar and wine to cut the smell and tenderize.
items.desc_zh: 白芷；或先泡出血水，再加醋和酒去膻、软化。

items.desc_en: Crispy coating, hard-fry, and airy tempura-style batters — ratios and best uses for each.
items.desc_zh: 脆皮糊、硬炸糊、气泡糊的配方与适用场景。

items.desc_en: 糖色, 拔丝, caramel stages — sugar types and when to use each in Chinese cooking.
items.desc_zh: 糖色、拔丝、焦糖阶段——各种糖在中式烹饪中的用法。

items.desc_en: Konjac powder glucomannan content, xanthan gum substitution ratio, and usage notes.
items.desc_zh: 魔芋粉葡聚糖含量、黄原胶换算比例与实际用量建议。

items.desc_en: How to rehydrate dried tofu skin (腐竹) — warm water and salt.
items.desc_zh: 腐竹泡发方法：温水加盐。

items.desc_en: Gelatin powder vs. sheets — ratios, bloom method, and how to substitute one for the other.
items.desc_zh: 吉利丁粉与吉利丁片的区别、用量换算与泡发方法。

items.desc_en: Heat control and the order ingredients go in — clear, milky, Cantonese slow-simmered, quick, thickened, double-boiled. Plus a 2-hour timeline and four rules.
items.desc_zh: 六种汤型的火候与下料顺序：清汤、奶白汤、老火汤、滚汤、羹、隔水炖；附 2 小时下料时间轴与四条铁律。

items.desc_en: Match your dipping sauce to the broth — mala, clear, Beijing lamb, Chaoshan beef, seafood, dry dip.
items.desc_zh: 根据锅底选蘸料——麻辣、清汤、老北京涮羊肉、潮汕牛肉、海鲜、干碟。

items.desc_en: Nutrition differences, brand quality, where to buy around Bellevue, and a decoder for the pack date stamped on the carton.
items.desc_zh: 营养差异、品牌质量、贝尔维尤一带去哪买，以及纸盒上装盒日期的解码工具。

items.desc_en: Whole vs skim, A2, grass-fed, organic — what every label on the carton guarantees, and which brands live up to theirs.
items.desc_zh: 全脂与脱脂、A2、草饲、有机——包装上每个标签到底保证了什么，以及哪些品牌名副其实。

items.desc_en: Types of flour, protein content, top brands, Canada-Japan supply chain, plus a protein blend converter.
items.desc_zh: 面粉种类、蛋白质含量、顶级品牌、加拿大—日本供应链，外加一个蛋白质混合计算器。

items.desc_en: Corn, potato, tapioca, wheat, sweet potato, mung bean and more — amylose, clarity and set compared, which starch for thickening, gels, frying or velveting, why custard turns watery, and a regional name decoder.
items.desc_zh: 玉米、土豆、木薯、澄粉、红薯、绿豆等淀粉的直链比例、透明度与凝固特性对比；勾芡、凝胶、炸物、上浆各用哪种；卡仕达为何变水；以及各地名称对照。

items.desc_en: Fish species, crab safety, and US shrimp varieties — identification, selection, and cooking methods.
items.desc_zh: 鱼类品种、螃蟹安全与美国虾种——识别、选购与烹饪指南。

items.desc_en: Cuts & grades, Cornucopia’s organic brand scorecard, and Bellevue buying tips including PCC sourcing standards.
items.desc_zh: 部位与等级、Cornucopia 有机品牌评分，以及含 PCC 采购标准的 Bellevue 购买建议。

items.desc_en: Labels → which bird → the sanhuang gap → which shop: what each claim is legally worth, brands ranked by breed and Cornucopia score, why a US bird is 47.5 days old and a sanhuang is 120, and the Seattle channels.
items.desc_zh: 标签 → 选哪只 → 跟土三黄鸡的差距 → 去哪买：每个标签在法律上值多少、按品种与 Cornucopia 评分排的品牌、为什么美国鸡 47.5 天而三黄鸡 120 天，以及西雅图的渠道。

items.desc_en: Yukon Gold vs Russet vs red — which potato for mashing, frying, or stewing.
items.desc_zh: 黄心、白心、红皮土豆的区别，以及哪种适合做泥、炸或炖。

items.desc_en: Black pepper enhances aroma; white pepper adds spicy heat. Know when to use which.
items.desc_zh: 黑胡椒提香，白胡椒有辣味。了解何时该用哪种。

items.desc_en: Pour-over params with a built-in brew timer, a two-test bitterness troubleshooter, beans I own, and a roaster shortlist.
items.desc_zh: 手冲参数（内置冲煮计时器）、苦味两步自查、我的豆子清单与烘焙商推荐表。

items.desc_en: Is bottled water needed for drinking, boiling and soup? Hardness, PFAS, lead & copper data against US, EU and Swedish PFAS4 standards, plus what to do without a filter.
items.desc_zh: 饮用、烧水和煮汤要不要买瓶装水？软硬度、PFAS、铅铜数据对照美国、欧盟与瑞典 PFAS4 标准，以及不用过滤设备时的做法。

items.title_en: Not All Organic Eggs Are Equal: Nutrition & Quality
items.title_zh: 并非所有有机鸡蛋都一样：营养与品质
items.desc_en: Why pasture-raised, free-range, and standard organic eggs differ in omega-3s, vitamins, yolk color, and more.
items.desc_zh: 放牧、散养与普通有机鸡蛋在欧米伽-3、维生素、蛋黄颜色等方面的差异。

items.title_zh: 有机鸡蛋品牌对比（Cornucopia 评分卡）
items.desc_en: Which organic egg brands actually live up to the label — from the most trusted independent rating of 150+ brands.
items.desc_zh: 哪些有机鸡蛋品牌真正名副其实——来自最受信赖的独立机构对 150+ 品牌的评分。

items.title_en: Best Eggs Around Bellevue: Is PCC Mobile Pastured It?
items.title_zh: 贝尔维尤最好的鸡蛋：PCC Mobile Pastured 是最优解吗？
items.desc_en: The numbers behind PCC's 5-egg rating, the two caveats it hides, and a where-to-buy table with addresses and distances from Bellevue.
items.desc_zh: PCC 5 颗鸡蛋评级背后的数字、它没写出来的两个问题，以及一张带地址和距离的贝尔维尤选购对照表。

items.desc_en: Today's Julian day, and what the 3-digit stamp on a carton means — real age, peak-quality window, when it will finally peel hard-boiled. Keeps a purchase log.
items.desc_zh: 今天的儒略日，以及纸盒上那三位数到底代表什么——真实天数、最佳品质期限、什么时候水煮才好剥壳。还能记录每次购买。

items.title_en: Milk Types & Nutrition: Whole, Skim, A2, Grass-Fed, Organic
items.title_zh: 牛奶的种类与营养：全脂、脱脂、A2、草饲、有机
items.desc_en: What actually differs between milk types — fat, omega-3s, CLA, vitamins, and the A1 vs A2 protein question.
items.desc_zh: 不同牛奶之间真正的差异——脂肪、欧米伽-3、CLA、维生素，以及 A1 与 A2 蛋白的问题。

items.title_en: Milk Labels Decoded: Organic, 100% Grassfed, Pasture Raised & the Rest
items.title_zh: 牛奶标签解读：有机、100% 草饲、牧场放牧及其他
items.desc_en: What each seal on the carton legally guarantees — feed, pasture, welfare, heat treatment and A2 — and which words mean nothing without a certifier behind them.
items.desc_zh: 包装上每个印章在法律上到底保证了什么——饲料、放牧、动物福利、杀菌工艺与 A2——以及哪些词没有认证机构背书时等于什么都没说。

items.title_en: Organic Milk Brand Comparison (Cornucopia Dairy Scorecard)
items.title_zh: 有机牛奶品牌对比（Cornucopia 乳品评分卡）
items.desc_en: Which organic milk brands deliver on the label — from Cornucopia's 5-cow rating system covering 160+ brands.
items.desc_zh: 哪些有机牛奶品牌真正对得起标签——来自 Cornucopia 5 颗奶牛评分体系，覆盖 160+ 品牌。

items.title_en: Flour Types & Protein: When to Use What
items.title_zh: 面粉种类与蛋白质：何时用哪一种
items.desc_en: All-purpose, bread, cake, pastry, 00, whole wheat — protein content, when each shines, and how to swap.
items.desc_zh: 通用粉、面包粉、蛋糕粉、糕点粉、00 号、全麦——各自的蛋白质含量、适合的用途，以及如何替换。

items.title_en: Flour Brands & Quality: King Arthur, Bob's Red Mill, Central Milling, and More
items.title_zh: 面粉品牌与品质：King Arthur、Bob's Red Mill、Central Milling 等
items.desc_en: How major flour brands stack up on consistency, protein content, organic certification, and what to buy for what.
items.desc_zh: 主要面粉品牌在稳定性、蛋白质含量、有机认证等方面的表现，以及不同用途该买哪一种。

items.title_en: Canadian Wheat → Japanese Flour: The Hidden Supply Chain
items.title_zh: 加拿大小麦 → 日本面粉：隐藏的供应链
items.desc_en: How Nisshin's Camellia and other famous Japanese flour brands are actually made from Canadian wheat — and why CWRS is the gold standard.
items.desc_zh: 日清制粉的 Camellia 等日本知名面粉品牌为何其实是用加拿大小麦做的——以及 CWRS 为什么是行业的黄金标准。

items.desc_en: Fish classification, Chinese names, and best cooking methods for each variety — steaming, braising, frying, and more.
items.desc_zh: 鱼类分类与中文名，以及各品种最适合的烹饪方式——蒸、焖、炸等。

items.desc_en: Stone crab, snow crab, blue crab, Dungeness, and hairy crab — contaminant risk ratings, habitat, and how to eat each safely.
items.desc_zh: 石蟹、雪蟹、蓝蟹、珍宝蟹、大闸蟹——污染风险评级、栖息地与安全食用建议。

items.desc_en: Spot prawns, Arctic sweet shrimp, sesame shrimp, tiger shrimp and more — Pacific vs. Atlantic, fresh vs. frozen, East Coast live tanks explained.
items.desc_zh: 斑点虾、北极甜虾、芝麻虾、黑虎虾等——太平洋与大西洋品种、鲜活与冷冻的区别，东海岸游水虾解析。

items.desc_en: Wagyu vs Prime vs Choice vs Select, which cuts suit which cooking methods, and how to choose at the store.
items.desc_zh: 和牛、Prime、Choice 与 Select 的区别，各部位适合的烹饪方式，以及如何在超市挑选牛肉。

items.desc_en: Cornucopia’s 1–5 cow scorecard for 150+ brands, plus Bellevue shopping tips — PCC standards, top 3 picks, and brands to avoid.
items.desc_zh: Cornucopia 对 150+ 个品牌的 1–5 头牛评分，加 Bellevue 本地购买建议——PCC 标准、最优三选及应避免的品牌。

items.subtitle_zh: 标签解读 · USDA 与第三方认证
items.desc_en: 7 labels — Organic, Pasture-Raised, Free-Range, Air-Chilled, No Antibiotics Ever, Non-GMO, Certified Humane — what each one guarantees, why it’s worth paying for, and where it falls short. Plus what the origin line is worth.
items.desc_zh: 7 个标签——有机、牧场散养、走地、风冷、全程无抗、非转基因、动物福利认证——各自保证了什么、值不值得买、以及局限在哪。外加产地那一栏值多少。

items.subtitle_zh: 品牌对照 · 8 个品牌与农场
items.desc_en: Which brands actually clear Organic + Pasture-Raised, why no package carries all three labels, breed and Cornucopia scores, and the GAP Step 4 rule for reading a supermarket shelf.
items.desc_zh: 哪些品牌真能同时做到有机 + 散养、为什么没有一个包装能凑齐三个标签、品种与 Cornucopia 评分，以及在超市现场用的 GAP Step 4 判据。

items.subtitle_zh: 土三黄鸡 · 品种与日龄
items.desc_en: 47.5 days versus 120: how far a US bird sits from a Cantonese sanhuang, why Chinese-raised birds cannot be imported at all, how to judge one by hand in the store, and what closes the gap — buying versus cooking.
items.desc_zh: 47.5 天对 120 天：美国的鸡离两广土三黄鸡有多远、为什么中国养的鸡根本进不来、在店里怎么上手判，以及差距靠换渠道还是靠做法补。

items.desc_en: 8 local channels — T&T, PCC, Whole Foods, H Mart Redmond, Xiongda Seafood, Dongjiang BBQ, and two group-buy sellers — with community feedback on each. Shops only; breed and provenance live in the two notes above.
items.desc_zh: 8 个本地渠道——大统华、PCC、Whole Foods、H Mart Redmond、熊大海鲜、东江烧腊店与两个团购——附网友评价。只管店，品种与货源在上面两篇里。
